conclusion: RNF213 is the only gene reported across informative moyamoya GWAS studies (2/2 with reported genes). No Fanconi-anemia-pathway gene appears at any moyamoya GWAS locus as of 2026-09-13. Caveat: GWAS detects common-variant population signal and would not capture a rare Mendelian FA-moyamoya co-segregation; absence here does not refute a rare association but shows no population-level FA-gene contribution to moyamoya.
